title: Assumed sole leadership of the family's flour-and-textile empire
statement: Assumed sole leadership of the family's flour-and-textile empire after his brother Rong Zongjing's death in 1938.

title: Refused Japanese demands to sell or cede control of the Rong
statement: Refused Japanese demands to sell or cede control of the Rong enterprises despite financial pressure and personal threats.
outcome: The Rong enterprise survived the war under Chinese family control rather than being sold to Japanese interests, per Wikipedia's biography.

title: Chose to remain on the Chinese mainland and cooperate with the
statement: Chose to remain on the Chinese mainland and cooperate with the incoming Communist government after 1949 rather than emigrate with capital to Hong Kong or Taiwan.
outcome: Rong Desheng and his family received favorable treatment from the new PRC government; his son Rong Yiren went on to become Vice President of the People's Republic of China in the 1990s.
